goal: Implement and verify M8 Integrated Evaluation and Local Canary with synthetic project-local evidence only.

nodes.task: Read only the M8 roadmap, PRD, evaluation, workflow, routing, security, operations, M5-M7 contracts, and relevant ADRs. Write an exact local-only evaluation/canary contract, acceptance matrix, public API/schema/data plan, evidence taxonomy, and deterministic test plan. Do not edit implementation paths.

Perform a read-only adversarial design audit of M8 datasets, graders, baselines, metrics, reports, local canary, rollback rehearsal, M5/M6/M7 boundaries, redaction, and local-only containment. Record fail-closed invariants and required regressions. Do not edit implementation paths.

Implement the project-local M8 evaluation runtime and fixtures from the audits: strict synthetic JSONL case contract, deterministic grading and baseline comparison, bounded redacted metric/report receipts, offline and simulated shadow-read-only canary, local rollback rehearsal, release-report generation, focused integration tests, and schema/contract wiring. Do not invoke providers, execute actions, make durable authority changes, or mutate global configuration.

Perform a final independent read-only security and regression review of completed M8 code, fixtures, generated local evidence, and tests. Verify baseline fairness, redaction, synthetic/live labeling, graph/direct boundaries, canary and rollback containment, and that no local artifact can authorize global or material action.

Run deterministic M8 acceptance checks, generate project-local baseline/evaluation/canary/rollback/release receipts, remediate material findings, write verification evidence and documentation, update status and next-session prompt to M9, and keep global activation disabled.
